title: The Piltdown Man Hoax
hook: Who forged the missing link that fooled scientists?
headline: The fake fossil that fooled science

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In 1912 amateur archaeologist Charles Dawson announced a skull fragment from Piltdown

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: The fragment measured 5 cm and showed a mixture of human and orangutan teeth

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Scientists later proved the teeth were modern orangutan and the bone chemically altered

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: In 1953 a fluorine test exposed the forgery confirming Dawson's deception

end.line: Do you think Dawson acted alone or had accomplices?

description: Explore the Piltdown Man hoax that fooled scientists for decades.
